verdict.rationale: The only export-related evidence is a narrow feature to 'Export a saved View exactly as you see it,' not a comprehensive data export mechanism; migration language found in the evidence is framed only around bringing data INTO Intercom from other helpdesks, not exporting all data out in open formats. Missing for 10: bulk/full account data export, documented open file formats (CSV/JSON), a migration-out or offboarding process, and any independent confirmation of successful full data extraction.
